These seven supplementary artifacts (five here, two in cmd/tbound/testdata/thesis-command-event) were generated in WSL tbound-dev from git archive 21881490238a0ee1692852f1f4cfb702b063142f on 2026-11-03. Only the two new supplementary test files and temporary generator wrappers were added to that baseline scratch tree. No modified production source was copied in, and expected bytes were never generated by the product branch.

The supplementary tests supply fixed inputs to the baseline serializers/receipt constructor. The baseline-only wrappers write thesisD09SupplementaryArtifacts and thesisCommandEventArtifacts to their respective testdata directories. Both comparison tests passed against the resulting baseline bytes before those bytes were exported. These are serialization fixtures, not live containment evidence.

The original product_d09_thesis_compatibility_linux_test.go is unchanged (working-file SHA-256 d1596b1ad36fa53a4459830bbfaf8aecaa7bf82e90224e8f1943e1c08398edc8).
